data.name: Anjumun
data.gender_notes: Anjumun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anjumun means 'protector' or 'preserver'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Anjam', which means 'protection' or 'defence'. This name is often given to children who are born during times of conflict or instability, as a reminder of the importance of protection and preservation. The name Anjumun carries the meaning “Protector, Preserver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Anjumun usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, preserver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anjumun is a name with deep spiritual significance. It reminds us of the role we play in protecting and preserving the world around us, both physically and spiritually. It is a name that inspires us to be strong, resilient, and compassionate, and to use our gifts and abilities to make a positive impact on the world.
data.etymology: Anjumun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Preserver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anjumun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أنجومن
in_arabic.meaning: نجوم و ستاروں کا مجموعہ، آسمان کی روشنیاں
in_arabic.long_meaning: أنجومن نام کا مطلب نجوم و ستاروں کا مجموعہ، آسمان کی روشنیاں سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جہاں 'أنجوم' کا مطلب 'نجوم' اور 'من' کا مطلب 'مجموعہ' یا 'کثرت' ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں آسمان کی روشنیاں اور ستاروں کی کثرت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جو روحانی معنوں میں بھی اہم ہے۔

in_urdu.name: انجومن
in_urdu.meaning: نجوم و ستاروں کا مجموعہ، آسمان کی روشنیاں
in_urdu.long_meaning: انجومن نام کا مطلب نجوم و ستاروں کا مجموعہ، آسمان کی روشنیاں سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی 'أنجوم' (نجوم) اور 'من' (مجموعہ) سے بنا ہے۔ اردو میں، یہ نام آسمان کی روشنیاں اور ستاروں کی کثرت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جو اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی اور خوبصورتی کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अंजुमन
in_hindi.meaning: नक्षत्रों और सितारों का संग्रह, आकाश की प्रकाश
in_hindi.long_meaning: अंजुमन नाम का अर्थ नक्षत्रों और सितारों का संग्रह, आकाश की प्रकाश से है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है, जहां 'अंजुम' का अर्थ 'नक्षत्र' और 'मन' का अर्थ 'संग्रह' या 'बहुलता' होता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में आकाश की प्रकाश और सितारों की बहुलता को दर्शाता है, जो आध्यात्मिक अर्थों में भी महत्वपूर्ण है।

in_pashto.name: انجومن
in_pashto.meaning: د ستورو او نجومو مجموعه، د آسمان روښاني
in_pashto.long_meaning: انجومن نوم معنی د ستورو او نجومو مجموعه، د آسمان روښاني څخه دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چیرته چې 'انجوم' د 'ستوري' او 'من' د 'مجموعه' یا 'کثرت' معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي تقويم په آسمان کې د روښانيو او ستورو کثرت ښيي، کوم چې په روحاني معنا کې هم مهم دی.

in_english.name: Anjumun
in_english.meaning: Collection of stars and celestial bodies, luminosity of the sky
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anjumun is derived from Arabic roots, signifying a collection of stars and celestial bodies, or the luminosity of the sky. The term 'anjum' translates to 'stars' and 'mun' implies 'collection' or 'abundance'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the spiritual significance of celestial bodies and their illumination. Historically, it reflects the importance of astronomy in Islamic scholarship and the beauty of the night sky.

The name Anjumun echoes this value and serves as a reminder to uphold this principle both in personal and communal life.

It is a reminder of the role of the Divine Protector, Allah, who shields us from harm and preserves us from evil. By adopting the name Anjumun, one is not only reminded of their responsibility to protect others, but also of their reliance on Allah, the ultimate Protector and Preserver. This name serves as a spiritual inspiration to be a source of protection and refuge for others, while also relying on Allah for guidance and strength.
